name: @w6w-apps/plivo
description: Send SMS/MMS, place and manage voice calls, search and manage phone numbers, and read account details via Plivo.

w6w.longDescription:
Plivo is a CPaaS (communications platform as a service) for SMS, MMS and voice. This app lets a workflow send text and picture messages, look up what happened to them afterwards, place outbound phone calls and hang them up, and manage the phone numbers and applications on a Plivo account.

Messaging covers sending (SMS or MMS, from a number you own or a Powerpack), fetching one message record, listing message records with filters, and listing the media attached to an MMS. Voice covers placing a call, fetching and listing call detail records, listing live calls, hanging up one call, cancelling a queued call request, and reading recording metadata. Numbers covers searching Plivo's inventory, renting a number, and listing, reading and updating the numbers already on the account. Applications (the Answer/Hangup/Message URL bundles that a number is pointed at) can be listed, read and created, and the account's own details and credit balance can be read.

A fit for appointment reminders, one-time codes, alerting by text or call, delivery-status reconciliation, and provisioning a number for a new customer as part of an onboarding workflow.
